narrative.overview: The site says only what hiring needs. Less is more: every extra element must earn its place. Visual interest comes from serif headings (Roboto Slab) and sans body (Geist), not decoration. Color stays ink-on-paper; motion stays a short route crossfade.
keyCharacteristics: Minimal surface: type and spacing only
True white paper, ink body, whisper metadata
Small radius (0.25rem); pills for CTA only
GSAP route transition with reduced-motion fallback

rules.name: The Pairing Rule
rules.body: Serif is only for h1 and h2. Sans is mandatory for body, nav, buttons, role line, and timeline roles. Mono is only for dates and stack.

rules.name: The Less Type Rule
rules.body: At most five distinct size/weight combos on a page. If a sixth is needed, remove something first.

rules.name: The Less Color Rule
rules.body: If a new color does not improve scan or affordance, do not add it.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Pages are paper plus type. No cards, panels, or glass.

dos: Do pair serif headings with sans body on every page
Do remove UI before adding UI
Do keep hire signal in the first screen
Do use ink for paragraphs and whisper for metadata only
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on route transitions
donts: Don't set body copy in serif or section titles in sans
Don't add cards, eyebrows, hero metrics, or gradients
Don't use cream backgrounds or gradient text
Don't introduce a second sans or decorative display face
Don't gate content on entrance animations
